# Feature: Timeline evidence

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #25 -->

## Intent
Run Detail shows a timeline where scenario markers and a selected sample peak share one time axis. Keyboard (or visible controls) zoom or switch presets. Under 768px the timeline falls back to a table. Evidence Panel labels raw vs derived vs source.

## Preconditions
- Run detail + golden artifact GET (#24)
- Golden samples can be reproduced (40 × frame_time 40ms, timestampNs 0..39)

## Happy Path
- [x] Timeline can show markers and a selected sample range
- [x] Core controls work without hover-only (keyboard or visible control)
- [x] Evidence Panel distinguishes raw vs derived vs source
- [x] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [x] prefers-reduced-motion: no 150ms+ animation
- [x] Narrow width: table fallback
- [x] Missing samples: empty/inconclusive, not a fake trace

## Regression
- [ ] Overview / Findings six blocks still work
- [ ] Token not in localStorage
- [ ] Scope: dashboard timeline + evidence panel + samples GET — no GPU debugger, no video replay

## Assumptions
- Golden run id `01J9GOLDENV100000000000000`
- Samples served from `GET /api/v1/runs/:id/samples` (same generator as golden builder)
- UI copy is English
- NFR-002 (1M samples) is out of this slice

## Security Coverage
- F-02: sample JSON parsed with type guards
- F-03: token stays in memory
- B-03: samples GET requires the run token
- P-04 analog: runId allowlist unchanged
- F-01 waived (loopback)

## Implementation Notes
- `GET /api/v1/runs/:id/samples` returns 40 golden `frame_time` samples (timestampNs 0..39, 40ms), matching the golden builder.
- Timeline tab: markers setup/warmup/measure/cleanup; All/Measure buttons; `[` `]` and arrow keys; selected peak prefers measure @ 20 ns when values tie.
- Evidence Panel headings Raw / Derived / Source. Narrow CSS shows the sample table and hides the track. `prefers-reduced-motion` disables transitions.

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
- Event: open run → GET artifact + samples → markers + selected range + evidence kinds.
- N-actors: 1 run → N samples on one axis; peak is one selected sample, not a score.
- Invalid: missing samples → empty copy, 404 does not invent a trace.
- Two consumers: GET read-only.
